title: Top 10 Event Management Companies in Bangladesh [2025 Updated List]
excerpt: Discover the leading event management companies in Bangladesh in 2025. From Ananta Events to Asian Expo, explore the top 10 industry leaders.
author: webadmin
content:
The event management industry in Bangladesh has grown significantly in recent years. In 2025, we see the Top event management companies in Bangladesh are striving to make corporate, social and cultural events more beautiful in the future. From conferences and international exhibitions to celebrity concerts, weddings and brand activations, these companies are setting new standards in creativity, delivery and execution. We have compiled a list of the top 10 event management companies in Bangladesh in 2025 based on their expertise, service and customer satisfaction.

Here is a list of the Top 10 Event Management Companies in Bangladesh, based on portfolio, reputation, innovation, and client satisfaction as of mid 2025.

1. Ananta Events & Entertainment — The Industry Leader

Ananta Events & Entertainment stands tall as the leading event management company in Bangladesh. Established in 2009, the company has built a strong legacy in executing high-profile corporate events, large-scale exhibitions, government summits, product launches, brand activations, and luxury weddings.

With its in-house production units in Dhaka and Chattogram, Ananta offers full turnkey event solutions — from creative concept development to flawless on-ground execution. The team is known for its creativity, professionalism, and attention to detail.

Notable Projects: BIAC International Arbitration Summit, Textech & DTG Trade Shows, Asia Pharma Expo, Government and Diplomatic Events, Fashion and Music Shows, Destination Weddings

Specialties: Corporate Events, Exhibitions, Concerts, Brand Activations, Luxury Weddings

2. Asiatic Events Marketing Ltd.

Asiatic Events Marketing Ltd. has carved a niche in brand activations, corporate campaigns, and experiential marketing. Their event strategies are deeply rooted in marketing objectives, making them ideal for product launches and promotional tours.

Specialties: Marketing-driven events, activations, promotions

3. Grey Bangladesh

Grey has expertise in all marketing disciplines, including digital, direct, activation, entertainment, sponsorship, public relations and multicultural.

Specialties: Weddings, private functions, cultural gatherings

4. CEMS Events

CEMS Events offers full-service event solutions, including exhibition management, AV production, and corporate shows. Their technical know-how and versatile services make them a go-to for product launches and conferences.

Specialties: Exhibitions, product launches, conference AV setups

5. SquadMind Global Ltd

SquadMind Global Ltd stands out by combining event execution with strategic marketing communication. Perfect for brands looking to launch a new product, open a flagship store, or create a memorable campaign.

Specialties: Brand campaigns, themed events, marketing activations

6. Mindscape Communication

With a name that translates to 'We Will Do It,' Mindscape Communication lives up to its vision with creative, impactful event concepts that often break conventional boundaries.

Specialties: Creative weddings, corporate concepts, cultural productions

7. BD Showbiz

BD Showbiz (also known as Bangladesh Event Management Services) dominates the entertainment event scene, particularly in organizing concerts, award shows, and celebrity appearances.

Specialties: Concerts, fashion shows, celebrity events

8. Event Touch International

Known for their energetic and innovative approach, Event Touch International specializes in corporate, social, and private events. Their strategic planning and flawless execution make them a trusted name in the market.

Specialties: Corporate launches, social events, brand campaigns

9. Native Expo International

A specialized name in exhibitions and trade fairs, Native Expo handles every element from booth design and construction to event logistics and operations.

Specialties: Trade shows, industry expos, B2B conferences

10. Asian Expo and Conference

Asian Expo and Conference brings a premium touch to weddings and corporate events with a focus on sustainability. Its partner entity Wizcraft Bangladesh is known for large-format events such as concerts, awards, and galas.

Specialties: Premium weddings, sustainable events, concerts

title: How to Plan the Perfect Wedding
excerpt: Learn the essential tips for planning your dream wedding event.
author: Event Manager
content:
Planning a wedding can be overwhelming, but with the right approach and timeline, you can create an unforgettable celebration.

Step 1: Set Your Budget and Timeline
The first step in planning a wedding is determining how much you want to spend and when you want to get married. This will help you make decisions about venue, catering, and other details.

Step 2: Choose Your Venue
Your venue sets the tone for your entire wedding. Whether you choose a church, garden, or ballroom, make sure it reflects your style and can accommodate your guest list.

Step 3: Create Your Guest List
Determine who you want to invite and send invitations at least 6-8 weeks in advance. Keep track of RSVPs to finalize your numbers for catering.

Step 4: Hire Your Vendors
Book your photographer, videographer, caterer, florist, and music/DJ well in advance. These professionals are crucial to making your day special.

Step 5: Plan Your Décor
Choose a color scheme and theme that reflects your personality. Flowers, lighting, and table settings can transform any space.

Step 6: Final Details
Pay attention to small details like place cards, favors, and a timeline for the day. These elements make your wedding memorable.

Remember, your wedding day is about celebrating your love with the people who matter most. Enjoy the planning process!
